news.title: India office gross leasing rises to record 61.06 million sq ft in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Gross office leasing across India’s top seven cities reached a record 61.06 million sq ft during January-September 2026, while net absorption rose 5.3% year-on-year to an all-time high of about 42 million sq ft. GCC leasing increased 30.6% YoY and accounted for 42.9% of total leasing.

news.title: Thiruvananthapuram: Technopark Phase III expansion gets environmental clearance
news.para: Technopark, located in Thiruvananthapuram, has secured the necessary environmental approval for its Phase-III expansion project. This significant milestone permits the development of IT facilities covering an area of 8.19 lakh sqm, aiming to create over 5,000 job opportunities. The project is also committed to strict environmental regulations, reinforcing flood management and sustainability through vigilant monitoring and reporting.

news.title: Upkeep agency blocks deliveries, house helps at Ajnara Homes in Greater Noida West over dues
news.para: Residents of Ajnara Homes recently decided to withhold maintenance fees for four months due to ongoing issues related to poor upkeep and unresolved complaints. In response, the builder's maintenance agency imposed restrictions on food deliveries and domestic help services, creating considerable hardship for residents who found themselves having to fetch groceries from the main gate.

news.title: Karnataka-RERA orders Eco Life Developers to hand over project documents & funds
news.para: The Karnataka Real Estate Regulatory Authority has mandated Eco Life Developers to establish a formal association of allottees, with a strict deadline of 60 days. This action follows a complaint from buyer Swetha Rangaswamy, who accused the developers of not meeting essential statutory requirements, including failing to demonstrate proof of the association's registration. The authority underscores the importance of addressing these obligations promptly.

news.title: USA: Home sellers are lowering their price and helping buyers to make a deal in a stagnant market
news.para: Homeowners nationwide are facing challenges in selling their properties amid a stagnant housing market and escalating mortgage rates. Many are finding themselves forced to reduce their prices and offer incentives just to attract buyers. This evolving market landscape is impacting vital life choices, including job relocations or downsizing. Consequently, a large volume of homes is left unsold for lengthy periods, intensifying the imbalance as sellers significantly outnumber potential buyers.

news.title: Delhi court upholds cheating case against M3M, its promoters in ₹450-crore land dispute
news.para: A Delhi court has upheld cheating and criminal conspiracy proceedings against M3M India Pvt Ltd and its promoters. The case involves allegations of a Rs 450-crore land fraud related to a land exchange deal. Allegations state that M3M obtained land without paying the required consideration according to the agreement. The court directed the accused to appear before the chief judicial magistrate on October 27.

news.title: Bombay HC junks order for further EOW probe against developer in Mumbai redevelopment case
news.para: The Bombay High Court overturned a magistrate's directive for further inquiry into a developer. Previously, the economic offences wing had closed the investigation due to a lack of substantial evidence. The developer argued that the complainant, Vinod Jain, had a record of frivolous complaints, with two earlier probes finding no validity in Jain's claims.

news.title: Hyderabad development body banks on Neopolis auctions for ₹2,000 crore haul
news.para: Next month, the Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority is set to auction off 114 land parcels, with a target of raising around Rs 2,000 crore. Prime areas under consideration include Kokapet, Raidurg, and Banjara Hills, which are expected to garner significant interest. The auction features parcels with established reserve prices, particularly spotlighting Kokapet's Neopolis layout.

news.title: Housing board scraps ‘betterment’ fee on land near its colonies in Ghaziabad
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh Housing Board has removed the betterment fee and no-objection certificate mandates for projects located within 500 metres of housing colonies in Ghaziabad. This revision is expected to simplify the development process by eliminating costly delays. This initiative is in harmony with the UP Building Construction and Development Byelaws 2025, aiming to boost urbanization and construction efficiency in the region.

news.title: Buyers get possession letters for Amrapali project as 86 others remain stuck in NCLT
news.para: After a prolonged wait, possession letters have been handed out to homebuyers at Amrapali Leisure Valley. This project is one of many caught in a web of insolvency proceedings in Gautam Budh Nagar and Ghaziabad, stretching back to 2016. Experts highlight that legal complications and staffing shortages have been major contributors to the ongoing delays.

news.title: Tiger Shroff sells luxury apartment in Mumbai’s Khar for ₹9 crore
news.para: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff has sold his 1,291 sq ft luxury apartment in Mumbai’s Khar West for ₹9 crore, with the transaction registered on October 22. He had bought the property directly from the developer in July 2018 for ₹7.61 crore, marking an increase of about 18.3% in its sale price.

news.title: JK Cement’s net profit rises 6% to ₹169.30 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: JK Cement has reported a solid 6.3% growth in net profit, reaching ₹169.30 crore for the second quarter, marking a significant year-on-year rise in total income by 22.8% to ₹3,771.29 crore. Grey cement sales volume surged by 21%, although the net profit for the first half of the fiscal showed an 8.2% decline.

news.title: GB Realty to invest ₹2,400-2,500 crore in Jacob & Co.-branded residences in Mohali
news.para: GB Realty, in partnership with Jacob & Co., has launched a high-end residential project on Airport Road in Mohali. The project demands an investment of around ₹2,400-2,500 crore, which includes land costs. With aspirations to dominate the luxury market, the company intends to invest upwards of ₹5,000 crore in luxury developments over the upcoming three years, highlighting its strategic growth across Northern India.

news.title: Bengaluru development body orders engineers to oversee upkeep of apartments past defect liability period
news.para: The Bangalore Development Authority has mandated that zonal commissioners take charge of maintaining expired defect liability apartments. Residents have raised concerns about the lack of clarity regarding maintenance duties and finishing pending tasks. Engineers are scheduled for frequent site inspections to address these residents' issues. Many are eager for defined accountability and a timeline for transferring control to their resident associations.

news.title: Delhi government approves urbanisation of 48 villages under DMC Act
news.para: The Delhi government has set its sights on transforming 48 villages to ensure synchronized urban development across the capital. Chief Minister Rekha Gupta highlighted the critical role of these villages in enhancing local amenities. The urbanization initiative will primarily target the southwest and outer north regions, aligning land use with the Draft Master Plan 2041 to uphold regulatory standards.

news.title: At least 27 highrise buildings in Pune civic body limits still have no final safety NOC from fire brigade
news.para: Currently, twenty-seven highrise buildings in Pune Municipal Corporation lack final no objection certificates for essential fire safety. The civic body has only provided temporary approvals, resulting in consistent inspections. With inadequate fire safety measures in place and a critical shortage of water, these buildings are at risk. Residents reportedly repurpose firefighting water for other needs.

news.title: Mysuru civic body to launch special e-khata drive on October 28
news.para: On October 28, Mysuru City Corporation will conduct a unique e-khata camp at its main office. Property owners can register for an e-khata for a nominal fee of Rs 175. Applications will be processed, and e-khatas are expected to be issued by October 31. The initiative aims to digitize around 2.3 lakh properties, with potential future camps scheduled every Friday based on property owner participation.

news.title: Local bodies in Tamil Nadu get expanded powers to approve building plans
news.para: The Tamil Nadu government has simplified the approval process for residential building plans by local bodies. Corporations and municipalities can now approve plans with greater floor space and more dwelling units. Town panchayats and rural bodies have also seen an increase in their approval limits. The height limit for residential and commercial buildings has been increased to enhance the availability of space.

news.title: ED raids 13 places across Delhi-NCR, Bengaluru, Chandigarh in fraudulent NRI housing loan case
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate conducted searches at 13 properties associated with a major money laundering case. Focused on fraudulent housing loans secured with forged documents for Non-Resident Indians, the investigation involves entities such as Antriksh Promoters and Developers Pvt Ltd and Sunshine Infrawell Pvt Ltd. The collection of evidence aims to uncover financial irregularities, potentially leading to the seizure of crucial documents and digital assets.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh housing board's NOC not needed for building plan approval
news.para: The housing department has announced that property owners will no longer require no-objection certificates from the UP Housing Board. This change abolishes outdated regulations from a 2010 directive, allowing direct submission of building plans to the Lucknow Development Authority. Additionally, betterment fees for housing board schemes will not be included with development authority project fees, streamlining the approval process to foster urban growth in the state.
